_about: OoTR shuffle_silver_rupees values other than 'vanilla' and silver-rupee pouches (dungeons plugin, tools/rando/parity/_dungeons_silver_shuffle.py; research: side note silver_rupees.md). The rooms themselves are in data/rando/silver_rupees.json. carriers: stand-in chest contents naming each silver-rupee item in the dungeons plugin's chest scenes (as data/rando/dungeons_world.json carriers; never shown or added), in the order of the items (for each puzzle in sorted order: 'Silver Rupee (P)', then 'Silver Rupee Pouch (P)'); every one is an item the generator already puts in chests (config/item_map.json). counter_ai: the shared counter AI (AI.Global) and the vanilla nodes the shuffled values edit, checked against the file before each edit. puzzles: per room, 'room' (OoTR's own wording of the room in its silver-rupee get text, data/lang/English/property.json), 'appear' (the room's saved appear flags, plain saved Bools: what a played file has once the counter appeared; set with the done flags), 'skip_done' (done flags this module never sets: the Gerudo Training Ground boulder room's done flag deletes both token groups through GerudoTrainingGround_Level_Room_02_Prefab_e14a nodes 0 -> 3/4 -> PrefabAllDelete, and its only other reader is the room's map step, _08f2 TriggerDungeonRoomStepClear).

counter_ai._about: update: the Simultaneous run every frame (SplitTiming Update); allget_child: the position of node allget (ExecuteLogicSetBool 'AllGet', the only path from the counter's native count to the room logic) among its children; dummy: an ExecuteGenericDummyAction copied in its place. count_selector: the on-load S32Selector over the linked tokens still alive (node 0); its case 0 child 'delete' (OneShotGenericDeleteThisActor) becomes 'stay', the default (the counter moves in front of its shutter).
